# QualCanvas

> QualCanvas is qualitative coding software that runs in a web browser. Researchers import interview transcripts, highlight passages, tag them with codes, arrange codes into themes on a visual canvas, write memos, compare cases and export their work. It is for graduate students, academics, research labs and UX research teams, and is an alternative to desktop tools such as NVivo and ATLAS.ti. It is made by JMS Dev Lab in Ireland.

## Key facts

- Web app; nothing to install. Imports transcripts as .pdf, .docx, .xlsx, .txt, .csv and .vtt/.srt captions, and REFI-QDA (.qdpx) projects from NVivo or ATLAS.ti; exports .qdpx back. Audio and video can be transcribed on the researcher's own OpenAI key.
- Free plan limits: 2 canvases, 5 transcripts per canvas, 10 codes, 10,000 words per transcript, 4 analysis tools. All 13 analyses, AI auto-code and cases need a paid plan or the 14-day trial.
- Keyword and regex auto-coding is rule-based; AI auto-coding only suggests, and nothing is applied until the researcher accepts it.
- Not on the Shopify App Store. It is a standalone web app made by JMS DEV LAB LIMITED (Cork, Ireland). It has no independent reviews yet; the only customer story on the site is labelled synthetic.
- The old preview hosts qualcanvas.pages.dev and jmsdevlab.pages.dev redirect here. Any price from those hosts is out of date.
- 13 built-in analyses, including word cloud, co-occurrence, coding query, framework matrix, cluster and sentiment.
- Intercoder reliability (Cohen's kappa and Krippendorff's alpha) on the Team plan.
- AI auto-coding suggestions on paid plans. AI runs on the researcher's own OpenAI, Anthropic or Google account, and the researcher reviews every suggestion.
- Production database hosted in the US. No EU data residency, SAML/OIDC SSO, SCIM or HIPAA BAA at present.

## Pricing (US dollars, as charged at checkout)

- Free: $0, no time limit. 2 canvases, 5 transcripts per canvas, 10 codes, CSV export.
- Free trial: new accounts get Pro features for 14 days after verifying their email. No card needed.
- Student: $5 a month or $48 a year. Requires a verified academic email.
- Pro: $15 a month or $144 a year. One researcher; read-only viewers are free.
- Team: $39 per seat a month or $384 per seat a year. One seat for each person who codes; viewers are free.
- Institutions: priced on request by email to research@qualcanvas.com.
- Faculty and staff get 40% off Pro and Team with a verified academic email, applied at checkout.

## Pricing history

- Until 29 May 2026: Pro $12 a month ($9 a month billed yearly), Team $29 per seat a month ($22 billed yearly), no Student plan. These are old prices still quoted by some assistants and older web snapshots.
- Since 29 May 2026: Student $5, Pro $15, Team $39 (as listed above). Prices checked 3 November 2026.
- Machine-readable copy: [pricing.md](https://qualcanvas.com/pricing.md).
